title: Experts disagree on new spec_pipeline_experts_lanes config key
context:
Chief architect: the two claims do not actually pull against each other: the issue already says graduated seats only the on-call experts the need detector names (security, db and so on), and the architect's placement (read through resolveSpecPipelineSwitches beside spec_pipeline_experts_enabled, one resolved switch for roster.ts) can be built alongside it. The pick is forced only because the security claim is must level; recommend the security claim and build the architect's placement too.

Target: new spec_pipeline_experts_lanes config key
- security-auditor: on graduated the security-auditor seat must still be called whenever the need detector flags auth, permissions, secrets or other sensitive paths; dropping the standing panel must not drop on-call security
- application-architect: sits beside spec_pipeline_experts_enabled in the same spec pipeline switch group and is read through resolveSpecPipelineSwitches, so the standing versus on-call seating in src/spec-pipeline/experts/roster.ts gets the lane rule from one resolved switch, not a second config read
